def _tree(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_directory(ctx.label.name)
    ctx.actions.run_shell(
        command = "mkdir -p $1/sub $1/empty && cp $2 $1/f && echo g > $1/sub/g && ln -s f $1/link && ln -s ../../../../../$2 $1/up",
        arguments = [out.path, ctx.file.src.path],
        inputs = [ctx.file.src],
        outputs = [out],
        mnemonic = "Tree",
    )
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]
tree = rule(_tree, attrs = {"src": attr.label(allow_single_file = True)})
def _shell(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".out")
    ctx.actions.run_shell(command = "tr a-z A-Z < $1 > $2", arguments = [ctx.file.src.path, out.path], inputs = [ctx.file.src], outputs = [out])
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]
shell = rule(_shell, attrs = {"src": attr.label(allow_single_file = True)})
